Next planned candidate: square low-t clustering, round04.

Square low-t clustering completed on 12 public images. PSNR 15.419368163935218 is 4.792961054057496 dB below cosine round03, so best_method.py remains the identical round03 snapshot. Frozen 25 steps and 100 NFE/image confirmed. Score unavailable because anchors are absent. Total elapsed 721.8745 seconds includes GPU waiting. Next: sine high-t clustering, then obtain first successful uniform and baseline results before choosing a refinement. Additional research idea: dyadic 1/128 endpoint grid makes endpoints and midpoints exactly bf16-representable while retaining 25 strictly positive intervals.

Sine high-t clustering completed on all 12 public images: PSNR exceeds cosine by approximately 0.0125 dB, a small advantage under the primary metric; update best_method.py to the exact round05 snapshot. NFE=100/image and 25 steps verified. Score unavailable because anchors are absent. First-five review: rounds01-02 failed before images; cosine and sine both approximately 20.22 dB, square 15.42 dB. Next round06 obtains the first successful uniform measurement, then round07 baseline. Follow-up candidate family: scaled-time-embedding-aware grid-125 schedules and grid-128 controls.

Uniform completed on 12 public images: PSNR 17.9593 dB is about 2.2655 dB below sine round05. The arithmetic benefit of exact scaled embedding times does not by itself guarantee reconstruction quality; keep sine best. Frozen 25 steps and 100 NFE/image confirmed. Score remains unavailable. Next round07 evaluates the preserved original time_shift baseline for its first successful image result; subsequently test stronger high-t shift and grid-aware variants.

Original time_shift baseline mu=0.63 completed for the first time on all 12 public images. PSNR 19.3616 dB is approximately 0.8632 dB below sine round05; keep sine best. The method hash is identical to failed round01, but this evidence is a fresh full dev-scorer run. Frozen 25 steps and 100 NFE/image confirmed, score unavailable. Coarse controls now complete. Next round08 increases high-t concentration using time_shift(mu=1.5).

Stronger time_shift(mu=1.5) completed on 12 public images. PSNR 19.6412 dB improves baseline but remains below sine round05. Anchors became available during this run: scorer produced the first real normalized score, 0.3239692203499083. Earlier scores remain null as originally emitted; no retrospective self-reported score replaces actual evaluation. Keep ordinary sine best. Frozen 25 steps and 100 NFE/image confirmed. Next evaluate prepared sine/grid125 schedule, then a grid128 control.

Sine/grid125 completed on all 12 public images with genuine score 0.45112298535799017. Exact scaled embedding-time alignment alone did not improve the primary mean PSNR: 19.7510 dB remains below ordinary sine 20.2248 dB. Keep original sine best. Quantization also changes small endpoint intervals, so isolate the raw-time dyadic control next: sine/grid128 in round10. NFE=100/image and 25 steps verified; no frozen changes.

Sine/grid128 completed on all 12 public images and became best: PSNR 20.9491 dB, actual scorer score 1.0, approximately 0.7243 dB above ordinary sine and above the reference anchor. Update best_method.py to the exact round10 snapshot. Ten-round review: initial two loading failures, uniform/square inferior, high-t sine and cosine strongest smooth controls, grid125 did not improve mean PSNR, dyadic grid128 did improve both PSNR and SSIM. Frozen 25 steps and 100 NFE/image verified. Next test smooth sine-power p=1.5; later probe dyadic curve refinements and power-of-two interval designs motivated by bf16 update arithmetic.

Smooth sine-power p=1.5 completed on 12 public images. PSNR 19.9359 dB and actual score 0.6652980284972935 do not beat dyadic sine/grid128 round10 (20.94911773068753 dB, score 1.0). Keep round10 best. Frozen 25 steps and 100 NFE/image verified. Next hypothesis: project the sine curve onto 25 intervals whose lengths are powers of two on grid128, using an image-independent dynamic program minimizing node deviation; this probes derivative-rescaling arithmetic while keeping all neural calls fixed.

Frozen25 steps and100 NFE/image verified.
